note: LC confirms David Stewart, second edition, Edinburgh: A. Constable, 1822, in two volumes. No candidate supplied.

original_title: Memórias de uma (outra) guerra: cotidiano e medo durante a Segunda Guerra em Santa Catarina
container: Doctoral thesis, Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina, Programa de Pós-Graduação em História, 2002.
note: The awarding university identifies the 2002 thesis and author. The later published book has separate editions; its LCCN is not assigned to this thesis. Repository access currently challenges automated requests.

The supplied author João Tçuzu does not identify the author of the 2000 FGV biography, Antonio Edmilson Martins Rodrigues (LCCN 2001299605). That book is plausible, but the corrupted author prevents a confident identification. The supplied graph candidate is a different author and book.

id: W:quijano|colonialidad del poder eurocentrismo y america latina|a
original_title: Colonialidad del poder, eurocentrismo y América Latina
container: Edgardo Lander (comp.), La colonialidad del saber: eurocentrismo y ciencias sociales. Perspectivas latinoamericanas (CLACSO, 2000), pp. 201–246.
note: Originally a 2000 chapter; the URL identifies its 2019 republication in Espacio Abierto 28(1), pp. 255–301. The journal page supplies matching citation_title and citation_author metadata. No identifier for the entire collection is assigned to the chapter.

id: W:moraes filho|festas e tradicoes populares do brasil

note: LC confirms the cited 1979 Itatiaia/EDUSP edition and this author form; Cascudo supplies revision and notes. The earlier work appeared as Festas populares do Brazil in 1888 and was subsequently expanded and retitled.

id: W:gaioso|compendio historico politico dos principios da lavoura do maranhao

note: The cited 1970 edition is a facsimile of the 1818 work. LC supplies this LCCN, the author and title, an 1818 imprint, and a 1970 call number; its HLAS record independently identifies the 1970 facsimile: https://www.loc.gov/item/hlas-bi78103980/.

original_title: Negotiated Settlements: Native Amazonians and Portuguese Policy in Pará, Brazil, 1758–1798
container: PhD dissertation, History, University of New Mexico, 2000.
note: The awarding university confirms Barbara A. Sommer, the exact dissertation title, and completion in 2000. No LCCN, ISBN, DOI, or individual thesis page with citation metadata could be verified; identifier fields remain empty.

original_title: Nordestino: uma invenção do falo — uma história do gênero masculino (Nordeste, 1920/1940)
note: The publisher explicitly names the author and ISBN and dates first publication to 2003. This ISBN identifies the later Intermeios edition, not the original Catavento printing; the earlier author mismatch arose from the abbreviated surname Jr.

original_title: Egensinne och skötsamhet: arbetarkulturen i Norrköping 1850–1940
note: Swedish national union catalogue confirms Björn Horgby, full title, Carlsson, Stockholm, 1993, and ISBN. None of the supplied Horgby works is this book.

The 1998 MEC/Secretaria de Educação Fundamental Parâmetros Curriculares Nacionais comprises multiple subject volumes and an introduction. The citation names neither a subject nor a volume and cannot identify one work; an introductory-volume identifier would be unjustified.
LC confirms Leif Lewin, Stockholm: Almqvist & Wiksell, 1967, Skrifter utgivna av Statsvetenskapliga föreningen i Uppsala, no. 46. This LCCN grounds the cited 1967 work.

original_title: A escrita da história: teoria e métodos
note: The Portuguese heritage-library catalogue confirms José Mattoso, full title, and ISBN for the 1997 Estampa edition of the work first issued in 1988. This is not one of the supplied Mattoso candidates.

original_title: Documentos de identidade: uma introdução às teorias do currículo
note: The university publisher’s bookshop confirms the title, Autêntica, 1999, author displayed as Tomaz Tadeu, and this ISBN. Google Books independently records the full author name Tomaz Tadeu da Silva and the same 1999 ISBN.

original_title: Plantation Memories: Episodes of Everyday Racism
note: Cobogó confirms this ISBN for Grada Kilomba’s 2019 Portuguese translation by Jess Oliveira and dates the English original to 2008. It identifies Memórias da plantação, not the unrelated title returned in the first pass. No graph candidate supplied.
